notes.title: Shield Yourselves
notes.content:
Get initial clicks and score protection  
Random mines are too tricky, so take your initial steps protected. 

[list]
[*] Initial tile reveal has now shield protection in case of Ink mine hit. 
[*] Score shield also protects your score multiplier. 
[*] Difficulty and mine count have been reworked. 
[*] On finish UI button controls have been updated. 
[*] Pressing Esc, while being inked, freeze has been fixed. 
[*] You can now skip the mine inked animation. 
[/list]
